method: All 108 originals compared in nine contact sheets, enlarged socket comparisons, and all 11 SVGs in the browser. Raster previews of SVGs were rejected because their converter failed clip/transform semantics; browser display is authoritative. Grouping preserves host, receptacle, topology and caption. Canonical points to unmodified original bytes. No runtime substitution or scope expansion.
